briefdescription.para: Demonstrates multi-master support in polled mode.

detaileddescription.para: Design example is to demonstrate multi-master support in polled mode. In case of arbitration lost, the example retries the transfer.

The XIicPs_MasterSendPolled() API is used to transmit the data and the XIicPs_MasterRecvPolled() API is used to receive the data. This example is tested on ZCU102 board and slave address needs to be changed based on board design.
This example can run on zynqmp / versal IIC device as master in polled mode and Aardvark test hardware used as slave.
It uses buffer size 132. Set the send buffer of the Aardvark device to be continuous 64 bytes from 0x00 to 0x3F.
